cid_scope: nearest containing multipart/related; nested scopes do not leak outward
body_role: only the chosen root/alternative is primary body; other subtrees still preserve roles and references

conversation.parent_candidate: last valid References id, otherwise single In-Reply-To id
conversation.references: retain complete ordered chain as evidence
conversation.conflicting_parent: retain both headers and conflict, do not silently discard
conversation.same_id: collapse only byte-identical source bytes; differing versions remain conflict variants
conversation.subject: never establishes a parent

html_policy: no scripts, event attributes, external loading or active attachments; escape unsupported markup
id_syntax: angle-bracket IDs used by fixtures; whitespace folds may be normalized, no case folding of the full identity
